crossRefs.note: “Remember now, Yahweh, I beg you, how I have walked before you in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that…
He said, “If you will diligently listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, and will do that which is right in his eyes, and…
You shall do that which is right and good in Yahweh’s sight, that it may be well with you and that you may go in and…
Hezekiah did so throughout all Judah; and he did that which was good, right, and faithful before Yahweh his God.
In every work that he began in the service of God’s house, in the law, and in the commandments, to seek his God, he did…
He sings before men, and says, ‘I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it didn’t profit me.
Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way.
Therefore the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy, and righteous, and good.
Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.
He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, and walked in all the way of David his father, and didn’t turn away to…
If you will walk in my ways, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as your father David walked, then I will lengthen…
When Solomon was old, his wives turned away his heart after other gods; and his heart was not perfect with Yahweh his…
It shall be, if you will listen to all that I command you, and will walk in my ways, and do that which is right in my…
because David did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, and didn’t turn away from anything that he commanded him all…
Asa did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, as David his father did.
He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, according to all that David his father had done.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, according to all that David his father had done.
translations.bsb: And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father David had done.
translations.kjv: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that David his father did.
translations.asv: And he did that which was right in the eyes of Jehovah, according to all that David his father had done.
